newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish air cargo traffic up 10.7 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Spanish air cargo traffic up 10.7 percent in June.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at the 39 airports managed by AENA (Spanish Airports and Air Navigation), rose 10.7 percent in June to 43,546 tonnes, AENA said.

Strong growth in traffic at Palma de Mallorca, Zaragoza and Lanzarote boosted the total. Cargo business at Palma rose 18.2 percent to 2,145 tonnes while Zaragoza handled 40.6 percent more cargo, or 1,107 tonnes. Lanzarote's cargo volume was 43.5 percent higher at 863 tonnes.
The accumulated total for all the AENA airports in the first six months of the year was 274,397 tonnes, up 13.5 percent from the same period 1996.
Passenger numbers at the 39 airports climbed 6.6 percent last month to 10.29 million and the number of aircraft movements was up 5.5 percent at 128,791.
